subject: general
question: The Ichamati River, recently seen in the news during Durga Puja immersions, is a:

options.text: Trans-boundary river between India and Nepal.
Tributary of the Ganga that flows entirely within India.
Bifurcation of the Mathabhanga River forming part of the India–Bangladesh border.
Perennial Himalayan river joining the Brahmaputra in Assam.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Heightened security was deployed along the India–Bangladesh border during Durga Puja immersions in the Ichamati River, which flows through both nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ichamati River** is a **trans-boundary river** shared by **India and Bangladesh. **It is a **bifurcation of the Mathabhanga River**, which itself is a **distributary of the Padma River. **
 
• The river **originates at Majhdia village** in **Nadia district (West Bengal)** and flows through **Nadia** and **North 24 Parganas** districts.
 
• It then forms a part of the **India–Bangladesh international boundary**, entering **Satkhira** and **Khulna** districts in Bangladesh before **discharging into the Kalindi River** and eventually the **Bay of Bengal** near **Moore Island. **
 
• Total length: **~216 km. **
 
• The river system includes **oxbow lake formations** near **Bangaon** in North 24 Parganas.
 
• Faces issues of **siltation**, leading to **water scarcity in dry seasons** and **flooding during monsoon.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major tributaries:** Ichamati, Jamuna, and Churni river systems.
 
• **Environmental concerns:** Reduced navigability, loss of aquatic biodiversity, and illegal sand mining.
 
• **Strategic importance:** Serves as a **cultural and ecological link** between India and Bangladesh, especially during festivals like **Durga Puja** and **Kali Puja.**
